|game_text=If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Opponent's total Force generation is -1 (and your total power everywhere is +1) for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit 2). Once per turn, if a card was just stacked on I Feel The Conflict, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. May lose 2 Force to cancel You Are Beaten or an attempt to steal Luke's Lightsaber. During your move phase, may turn a card stacked on I Feel The Conflict face up to relocate Luke between a battleground site and your Death Star II site.

* '''PC-E1''' ([[His Destiny (Errata)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/hisdestiny.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/hisdestiny.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Indeed You Are Powerful: Once per turn, if you just won a battle or duel, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. I Have To Face Him: Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. Father, Please!: Non-[Set 13] Anakin Skywalker does not cause Force loss and, once per game, you may lose 1 Force to play it from outside your deck as if from hand.”<ref name="cj-e1137c3">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/e1137c3 swccg-card-json commit e1137c3] “More cards and fixes” (15 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The text after “If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table.” was rewritten under three named headings. Removed: the Force generation −1 / power +1 bonus for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy, the I Feel The Conflict trigger for the Reserve Deck peek, “May lose 2 Force to cancel You Are Beaten or an attempt to steal Luke’s Lightsaber.” and the move-phase relocation by turning a stacked card face up. New: “Indeed You Are Powerful: Once per turn, if you just won a battle or duel, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. I Have To Face Him: Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Luke to same battleground as Prophecy Of The Force. Father, Please!: Non-[Set 13] Anakin Skywalker does not cause Force loss and, once per game, you may lose 1 Force to play it from outside your deck as if from hand.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
